description: This PHP script renders and manages the 'Edit View' interface for Campaign Trackers in the SuiteCRM platform, involving form handling, display logic, and interactions with the bean model.

classes.name: javascript
classes.description: A utility class used to handle JavaScript validation and dynamic form scripting within the view.

methods.name: setFormName
methods.description: Sets the form name for JavaScript validation and scripting.

methods.name: setSugarBean
methods.description: Associates a SugarBean object with the JavaScript helper to facilitate validation.

methods.name: addAllFields
methods.description: Includes JavaScript validation for all form fields.

methods.name: getScript
methods.description: Outputs the assembled JavaScript required for client-side validation and interaction.
